_doc: Negative-proof ledger. A control is trusted only after an attributed failure on a deliberate break and a verified restored pass.

gates.description: Requires every continuation of an assistant answer to carry bounded, labelled parent-question context.

observedFailure.reason: The fixture first proved that the context-envelope helper was bypassed, then failed because the gate admitted a continuation without inherited user context.

gates.description: Fails when a tracked Markdown file contains a broken repo-local relative link.

observedFailure.reason: In a disposable git fixture, committed broken.md with [missing](./does-not-exist-gate-proof.md). The real checker exited 1 and named that exact target. Clean fixture and restored tree both exited 0.
observedFailure.restoredPass: Same script continued through restore (git rm broken.md) and exited 0 overall; markdown-links section printed restore=0 OK.

gates.description: Requires mempalace/version.py, pyproject.toml, and plugin manifests to agree; tag pushes must match on stable tags.

observedFailure.reason: Copied the five version sources into a temp tree and set pyproject.toml version to 0.0.0-gate-proof. Local agreement mirror reported ok=false with that value present. Restored the original pyproject text and agreement returned ok=true. Workflow contract still requires 'Verify all sources agree' and tag-match steps.
observedFailure.restoredPass: Restored pyproject matched baseline; agreement ok=true; workflow SHA unchanged.

gates.description: Skips pull_request when head_ref is dev so a long-lived promotion PR does not double-bill runners already covered by push.

observedFailure.reason: Temp-mutated a copy of ci.yml replacing github.head_ref != 'dev' with a never-match guard. Contract check failed naming the missing fragment github.head_ref != 'dev'. Repo file SHA-256 unchanged after the proof.
observedFailure.restoredPass: Live ci.yml still contains the skip-dev guard, windows job, and concurrency block; proof exited 0.

gates.description: Builds and deploys docs only from main (not the stale develop branch).

observedFailure.reason: Temp-mutated branches: [main] to branches: [develop]. Contract failed for missing fragment 'branches: [main]'. Live workflow SHA unchanged.
observedFailure.restoredPass: Live deploy-docs.yml still requires main, bun run docs:build, and actions/deploy-pages@v5; proof exited 0.

gates.description: Fails the sync job on mergeUpstream HTTP 409 so conflicts are not silent warnings.

observedFailure.reason: Temp-replaced core.setFailed with core.warning in a copy. Contract failed for missing fragment 'core.setFailed'. Live workflow SHA unchanged.
observedFailure.restoredPass: Live sync-upstream.yml still calls mergeUpstream, checks err.status === 409, and uses core.setFailed; proof exited 0.
